summary.headline: Modena Codices 15 and 40
summary.text: Descriptions of Modena Codices 15 and 40, including a nativity diagram with an explanation of the twelve sections, an anonymous four-hundred-chapter explanation of Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Porphyry’s introduction to apotelesmatics, a Demophilus scholion, and Paul of Alexandria on house rulership. The entries identify manuscript owners, scribes, editions, and related Florentine codices.
